entries.name: 惯导输出时序与有效性
日志完成写入与存储健康

semantics.access: Only these source/symbol/member tuples, resolved anew from matching ELF/DWARF, may be read. No user expressions, pointers, callbacks, writes or arbitrary arrays.
semantics.time: Raw MCU microsecond timestamps are not host time or measured current sample age. Host receipt age is separate. Zero valid field means unpublished; read does not prove online/READY/START.
semantics.sequence: Only estimator timing has an existing sole-writer odd/even sequence protocol. Read sequence, fields, sequence once; differing or odd discards the row. No unlimited retry.
semantics.identity: ELF SHA binds the selected file; complete nonempty PT_LOAD flash bytes must match the live target before diagnostic reads. No authentication or atomic whole-flash snapshot is implied. No external flash, MMIO or unmapped segments.
